entities.name: 2,4-dichloro-5-fluoronitrobenzene
observations: Exact ORD-matched substrate: O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Cl)c(F)c(Cl)c1; reduced to the corresponding aniline. ORD reaction ord-625d9b2d6f704099ba30c2805d573de5.

entities.name: 2,4-dichloro-5-fluoroaniline
observations: Exact ORD-matched product: Nc1cc(Cl)c(F)c(Cl)c1; both aryl chlorides and aryl fluoride remain intact after nitro reduction.

entities.name: ORD-625d9b2d6f704099ba30c2805d573de5
observations: ORD records reduction of 2,4-dichloro-5-fluoronitrobenzene to 2,4-dichloro-5-fluoroaniline using zinc, ammonium ion, formate, methanol, and water; no time, temperature, or yield was reported in retrieved evidence.

entities.name: Zinc/ammonium formate
observations: Recorded reagent system for the exact nitroarene-to-aniline reaction includes Zn metal, ammonium ion, formate, methanol, and water; consistent with zinc/ammonium-formate reduction.
